intended_rationale: Aft draught exceeds the maximum ice-class draught.

source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: The maximum and minimum ice class draughts at fore and aft perpendiculars shall be determined in accordance with the upper and lower ice waterlines and the draught of the ship at fore and aft perpendiculars, when ice conditions require the ship to be ice-strengthened, shall always be between the upper and lower ice waterlines.

contract.comparisonModel: The maximum and minimum ice class draughts at fore and aft perpendiculars shall be determined in accordance with the upper and lower ice waterlines and the draught of the ship at fore and aft perpendiculars, when ice conditions require the ship to be ice-strengthened, shall always be between the upper and lower ice waterlines.
contract.formulaExpression: minimumIceClassDraughtFore <= operatingForeDraught <= maximumIceClassDraughtFore and minimumIceClassDraughtAft <= operatingAftDraught <= maximumIceClassDraughtAft.

oracle_scope: Retained source-backed representation contract plus canonical schema; not full-vessel regulatory compliance

messages: Operating fore and aft draughts must each be between the corresponding minimum and maximum ice-class draughts.
violations.query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:operatingForeDraught ?ofq .
                ?ofq qudt:numericValue ?of .
                $this nltl:operatingAftDraught ?oaq .
                ?oaq qudt:numericValue ?oa .
                $this nltl:minimumIceClassDraughtFore ?minfq .
                ?minfq qudt:numericValue ?minf .
                $this nltl:maximumIceClassDraughtFore ?maxfq .
                ?maxfq qudt:numericValue ?maxf .
                $this nltl:minimumIceClassDraughtAft ?minaq .
                ?minaq qudt:numericValue ?mina .
                $this nltl:maximumIceClassDraughtAft ?maxaq .
                ?maxaq qudt:numericValue ?maxa .
                FILTER (
                    !(?minf <= ?of && ?of <= ?maxf &&
                      ?mina <= ?oa && ?oa <= ?maxa)
                )
            }

violations.query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this
WHERE {
    $this nltl:operatingForeDraught ?ofq .
    ?ofq qudt:numericValue ?of .
    $this nltl:maximumIceClassDraughtFore ?maxfq .
    ?maxfq qudt:numericValue ?maxf .
    $this nltl:minimumIceClassDraughtFore ?minfq .
    ?minfq qudt:numericValue ?minf .
    $this nltl:operatingAftDraught ?oaq .
    ?oaq qudt:numericValue ?oa .
    $this nltl:maximumIceClassDraughtAft ?maxaq .
    ?maxaq qudt:numericValue ?maxa .
    $this nltl:minimumIceClassDraughtAft ?minaq .
    ?minaq qudt:numericValue ?mina .
    FILTER (
        ?of < ?minf ||
        ?of > ?maxf ||
        ?oa < ?mina ||
        ?oa > ?maxa
    )
}
